name: v12_deferred_revenue_growth_reversal_quality
hypothesis: v11 deferred-revenue growth was a near-miss. Add a small intraday reversal and light quality anchor to lift Sharpe/Fitness without making the parent factor dominant.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Refines qMAj1o2O by replacing part of sales-growth weight with the proven low-correlation intraday reversal ingredient.

name: v12_deferred_revenue_growth_gross_margin
hypothesis: Deferred revenue growth should be stronger when backed by gross margin. This tests demand visibility plus profitability quality.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Uses gross margin instead of sales_growth to reduce sub-universe weakness.

name: v12_deferred_revenue_growth_receivables_quality
hypothesis: Deferred revenue growth and low receivables/sales are complementary working-capital quality signals: prepayment visibility versus collection risk.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * receivable / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: May correlate with LLp7PRmM; submit only if PnL correlation stays below threshold.

name: v12_capex_sales_discipline_cashflow
hypothesis: Capex intensity relative to sales may be a cleaner investment-discipline measure than capex/assets, especially when backed by operating cash flow.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_expenditure_amount / sales, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_flow_from_operations / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Refines MPp7RPxn by changing the denominator from assets to sales and using slightly higher decay.

name: v12_capex_discipline_gross_margin
hypothesis: Low capex intensity is more valuable when gross margin is strong, indicating capital-light quality rather than underinvestment.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_expenditure_amount / sales, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: A capital-light quality variant; should be less analyst-yield-like than EBITDA/EV.
